decisions.title: Event-driven modular transfer execution
decisions.rationale: Asynchronous transfer execution decouples intake from long running jobs
tradeoffs: Event reliability needs explicit recovery; simpler than one service per protocol

findings.description: Clarify idempotency of interrupted multipart completions
